method: Original V326 exact stem/ABC/source freeze. Official consolidated pages accessed live 2026-11-22, relevant article and neighbor conditions compared, no professional/independent signoff. Normative content paraphrased in evidence locators, original ANRE text retained verbatim from project source packet.

cases.original_question: Obţinerea avizului tehnic de racordare de către un utilizator:

original_options.A: nu este obligatorie pentru o durata mai mică de 6 luni
original_options.B: nu este obligatorie pentru o putere ceruta sub 100 kW
original_options.C: este obligatorie pentru orice loc de consum/producere nou

locators: Art.5(1)(a)-(c): new production, new permanent OR temporary consumption, new consumption+production require connection request
Art.11(1): connection application for each site regardless of duration or requested power
Art.24: ATR is grid operator offer at applicant's request
Art.25(1): ATR is issued by network operator based on determined connection solution

analysis.A: Time under six months does not waive the Art.11(1) application for a new temporary consumption site; source supports rejecting unconditional exemption.
analysis.B: Power below 100 kW does not waive the Art.11(1) application; no such universal exemption in this rule.
analysis.C: Supports standard new grid-connection procedure through request and issued ATR, but the word 'orice' and obtaining vs requesting ATR require checks for all exceptions, special regimes, impossible/refused applications.

cases.original_question: În cazul unui ansamblu de blocuri de locuinţe, grupurile de măsurare individuale se poziţionează

original_options.B: centralizat, la limita zonei de proprietate asupra terenului, in exteriorul construcţiei
original_options.C: centralizat, la parter sau pe palier

locators: Anexa nr. 3, pct.2.1-2.3, especially 2.3: individual meters in housing blocks placed centrally at ground floor or landing

analysis.A: In-apartment electrical panels are a different location from the expressly specified centralized meter groups.
analysis.B: Property-land boundary in exterior construction is not the relevant norm for individual metering groups inside blocks; confuse the boundary of an electrical network with meter placement.
analysis.C: Directly matches Annex 3 §2.3 for a group of apartment blocks. Neighbor §2.2 concerns the LV network in the housing complex, not a different meter-location exception.

cases.original_question: Un electrician autorizat care execută lucrări de instalaţii electrice:

original_options.A: Are obligaţia de a respecta proiectul în baza căruia execută instalaţia electrică
original_options.B: Are obligaţia de a participa la recepţia şi la punerea în funcţiune a instalaţiei electrice de utilizare proiectată/ executată, chiar dacă nu i se solicită acest lucru de către beneficiarul sau operatorul de reţea la care urmează a se racorda instalaţia electrică de utilizare;
original_options.C: Are dreptul de a racorda la SEN noi puncte de consum, urmând a solicita acordul operatorului de reţea după recepţia la terminarea lucrărilor

locators: Art.37(d),(e): execute works on approved project and respect project; report nonconformities to designer
Art.37(h): participate in reception and commissioning when requested by beneficiary or network operator
Art.37(i),(j): request energization after reception and contracts, no work on network components without operator agreements

analysis.A: Art.37(e) expressly requires respect of the project used to execute the installation.
analysis.B: Question's 'chiar dacă nu i se solicită' conflicts with Article 37(h)'s explicit 'în cazul în care i se solicită'.
analysis.C: A unilateral connect-to-grid then request later conflicts with required operator approvals and commissioning procedures, Art.37(c),(i),(j).

original_options.A: pot impune furnizorului orice modalitate de plată, chiar dacă nu este pusă la dispoziţie de către acesta
original_options.B: pot să opteze pentru orice modalitate de plată pe care furnizorul o pune la dispoziţie
original_options.C: sunt obligaţi să achite facturile pentru energia electrică la una din casieriile furnizorului

locators: Legea 123/2012 Art.57(2): supplier offers several payment methods and household customer may choose from those
Art.57(2^1): e-billing and flexible payment options

analysis.A: No right to impose any method not offered by supplier under Article 57(2).
analysis.C: Obligation to pay exclusively at supplier cashier is inconsistent with several selectable available methods.

limitations: G1-LEG-024 original says obtaining ATR for every new site, while articles also establish requirement to REQUEST new connection; 'orice' universal and obtaining issuance exceptions remain a separate scope/edition gate.
